Paranormal? Sure - I have several - but this is the best:

About 35 years ago I was hitchhiking my way North on the Trans-Canada Highway, just North of Sudbury. Early in the morning - the Sun had just come up, and there was very little traffic so far - so the sun was still lowish in the sky and reflecting off the highway. It was cold. This van was coming down the highway and I was getting ready with my sign.

As the van approached to about 100 yards or so - moving at full highway speed - a cat ran across the road in front of it - chased by a second cat - a black cat. The first cat made it across in time, but the second cat was sucked up under the van and basically exploded - poof - and it was gone. A little puff ball of black fur blew right up and into my feet as the van continued on by.

Kind of shocking to see that.

Every day, or every other day, past that day, a black cat crossed my path. If I proceeded in my original direction and crossed the path of the black cat - something bad happened. I soon learned to change direction whenever this happened. Even my friends - who didn't believe me at first, soon learned to follow this advice because sometimes the bad thing happened to them instead.

This black cat thing went on like this for three years. Then it just stopped happening. Now I hardly ever see one - but if I do, I never cross it's path.

This is a true story.

Ok, this thread has been entertaining so I'll share one. I've had so many experiences over the years that I've come to think I might be what I'd call "sensitive" to it. Hell I even categorize my dreams now. Anyway, this one is a bit more tangible. (Please excuse the brevity, I'm on mobile ATM)

A few years ago, my wife and I were living in a pretty old house. Lots off odd things happened from time to time, but we are pretty rational, so we didn't make too much of it. One morning we were getting ready for work and the dryer buzzer went off in the basement. We kinda looked at each other and I asked...nope...no laundry was being done. Kinda just shrugged and continued on. A couple minutes later it went off again.

At this point I had to go check. I went down to the creepy basement and looked. Nothing was running, no clothes in the dryer, etc. so I went back upstairs. Another minute went by and BUZZZZ! It stumped me so I went back down. Nothing. I unplugged it from the wall and went back upstairs. She had to leave before me so we laughed about it and she went to work, confident that I fixed the glitch and I went about my business. BUZZZ! I was kind of at a loss so I went back down and unplugged pretty much everything that remotely could make noise (dehumidifier, etc, although I knew the dryer sound.). Went back upstairs...AGAIN! BUZZZ!!

I went back to the creepy basement and yelled that it wasn't funny anymore and it needed to stop. It never happened again and we moved when the lease was up. (Like I mentioned, there were other weird occurrences also.) From what I've seen since, no one else has stayed in that house for long either.

I should note that I never really felt anything "dark" or malevolent...that situation felt more like a prankster, but still enough unnerving things to not be comfortable there.
